rv.q: Bravo to the producers for bringing this highly pertinent, scintillatingly staged and deeply disturbing piece of theatre to the West End.
'TheNether' is a relentlessly the most difficult moral issues gripping, entertaining play.
Although the concept caught my interest, exploring these ideas was often poorly executed and failed to engage me in much of the story.

cn.t: Critics praise this "smart" and "scintillatingly staged" sci-fi thriller about a disturbing virtual reality future, calling it highly pertinent and chilling in its exploration of online crimes without consequence.
